data: Qui croirait que la championne internationale des villes en transition est une petite commune française ? C’est pourtant Rob Hopkins, fondateur du mouvement des villes en transition, qui le dit. Qu’est ce qu’on attend ? raconte comment une petite ville d’Alsace de 2 200 habitants s’est lancée dans la démarche de transition vers l’après-pétrole en décidant de réduire son empreinte écologique. (Who would believe that the international champion of Cities in Transition is a small French town? It is however what Rob Hopkins, the founder of the Cities in Transition movement, declares. This film recounts how a small Alsation town of 2,200 inhabitants launched into the process of post-petrol transition by deciding to reduce its ecological footprint.)

Who would believe that the international champion of Cities in Transition is a small French town? It is however what Rob Hopkins, the founder of the Cities in Transition movement, declares. This film recounts how a small Alsation town of 2,200 inhabitants launched into the process of post-petrol transition by deciding to reduce its ecological footprint.
